status_detail.review_fixes_are_source_only: src/http/server.cj, src/internal/http2/server_connection.cj and src/internal/http_resource_budget.cj were not modified by this branch; they are listed because the merged owner PR changed them and the inventory must bind them.

issue-266.title: Commit IDs only when the event block is dispatched
issue-266.change: src/sse/decoder.cj keeps a parsed id field pending and copies it to the committed cursor only at the blank delimiter, so an EOF-truncated block cannot advance the reconnect cursor past an undispatched event.

issue-267.title: Return completed EOF before checking the lifetime context
issue-267.change: src/sse/writer.cj read() now observes complete() with an empty ring before sampling the lifetime context, so a cancellation or deadline that lands after the terminal EOF still yields zero instead of an abort; an interrupted wait with queued bytes keeps reporting cancellation/expiry.

issue-268.title: Bind every changed production file into task evidence
issue-268.change: tools/tasks/M11-001.json now lists src/http/server.cj, src/internal/http2/server_connection.cj and src/internal/http_resource_budget.cj with their associated tests in both allowed_paths and source_paths, so seal_evidence() hashes them. The pre-review receipts moved to historical/ so no current seal can cite them.
